open_files_after_build.fact: The user wants every completed file (HTML apps, games, dashboards, etc.) automatically opened in the browser/desktop app via the open_in_browser_or_app tool immediately after finishing building or updating it. Never finish a build without opening the result.

launch_html_protocol.fact: When building or updating .html files, visual apps, or dashboards, do NOT use explorer.exe or default open.
